claim: Larger base model capacity better absorbs domain-specific knowledge, leading to higher absolute performance after domain-specific post-training.
falsifier: Train models of varying capacities (e.g., 1B, 8B, 32B) with the same domain-specific post-training pipeline on a fixed domain; measure final performance and verify monotonic improvement with capacity.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system (Qwen3-based models from 8B to 32B parameters), task (SFC certification exams), and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Base model capacity–absolute performance after domain-specific principle
